svg.text: Kavach: WhatsApp scam shield for Indian families, on AWS
Region ap-south-1 (Mumbai) · optional email checking in ap-southeast-1 (Singapore) · grey arrows = coming in, amber = going out to people, dashed = optional or owner-only
stop EC2 after a Yes tap
Media to S3, voice to text
Kavach agent (Strands) · Amazon Nova 2 Lite on Amazon Bedrock (global inference profile)
Own prompt, tools and memory · view-only: instances, spend, Kavach health, templates
Can only request start, stop or reboot: the owner's Yes tap runs it
Amma forwards a message on WhatsApp → SNS → Inbound Lambda (voice to text, media to S3)
→ AgentCore: 1 evidence in code, 2 Nova 2 Lite investigates and acts, 3 guard checks the reply
→ reply and business buttons on WhatsApp; family alert template; emails through SES
→ EventBridge timers escalate to family and check that 1930 was called
Lambda functions: Python 3.12 on arm64 · shared settings in SSM /kavach/config · media deleted after 7 days · consent first, STOP turns Kavach off
